title: M31A v0.1.13 Released: Sovereign 39-Crate Rust Workspace & Multi-Agent Swarms
summary: M31A transitions to a modular 39-crate Cargo monorepo in Rust 2024 edition, introducing distributed task meshes, Bubblewrap namespace isolation, and official Python & TypeScript client SDKs.
content: M31A has undergone a comprehensive architectural evolution, migrating from a monolithic engine to a decoupled 39-crate monorepo under Rust 2024 Edition.
Key capabilities introduced in this milestone include the speculative parallel reality arena, distributed agent task mesh with path locks, and industrial-grade JSON-RPC 2.0 daemon servers.
Developer libraries @m31a/sdk for Node.js/TypeScript and m31a for Python are now officially available on npm and PyPI.

title: NVIDIA NIM Frontier Model Acceleration Integration
summary: M31A establishes zero-latency SSE token streaming and real-time model discovery across DeepSeek R1, Llama 3.3, and Nemotron through NVIDIA NIM containerized microservices.
content: Through NVIDIA NIM integration, M31A achieves sub-200ms time-to-first-token inference across local RTX hardware and hosted NVIDIA API endpoints.
Dynamic context window auto-compaction and live /v1/models query endpoints enable seamless model switching directly from the Ratatui TUI cockpit via Ctrl+M.

title: Defense-in-Depth Security Model & Sandbox Containment Specification
summary: Comprehensive security architecture formalizing unprivileged Linux user namespace containment, non-bypassable read-only filesystem masks, and Guardian circuit breakers.
content: All untrusted autonomous code execution is executed within isolated Linux Bubblewrap containers. The filesystem mask permanently defends sensitive paths including .git/, .m31a/, and environment files (.env).
Guardian circuit breakers automatically intercept high blast-radius commands (destructive rm, system modification) and require explicit human-in-the-loop authorization.

title: Official TypeScript & Python SDKs Reach General Availability
summary: First-party SDK packages @m31a/sdk on npm and m31a on PyPI provide production-ready bindings for CI/CD pipelines, IDE extensions, and automation scripts.
content: Developers can now orchestrate M31A autonomous agents programmatically in Node.js and Python. The SDKs feature async iterable streaming, approval interception, and multi-transport IPC.
Mock transport drivers are included out of the box to enable fast, deterministic unit test harnesses in developer CI pipelines.
